SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location, Position and Size of Kenya.
   B. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.

   A. Explain Development of Transport with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
